Ivy: quick thread to lock down pager vs transport responsibilities before the RFC follow-up. thinking we should standardize names but keep language idioms.
Marcus: agreed. prefer: ListWidgets, ListWidgetsPager, ListWidgetsStream. Pager yields pages (metadata + items), iterator yields items.
Lina: big open: where do retries live? my vote: transport owns idempotent retries (with Retry-After honor). Pager owns boundary-level retries (fetching next_token) and exposes a retry_policy option.
Marcus: +1. also: resume tokens must be opaque strings. SDKs should detect a short prefix like "v1:" so migrations don't break older clients.
Ivy: edge case: grpc server-stream with no tokens. propose adding a stream->pager adapter that emits page markers when server includes them, otherwise buffer up to `max_page_items` then yield. configurable and off by default.
Lina: tests: token roundtrip, token version bump test, stream->pager buffering perf. add cross-lang parity job.
Marcus: go ergonomics: Pager.Next(ctx) -> bool; Pager.Items() []Widget; Pager.Err() error. avoid hidden goroutines.
Ivy: python: async iterator + sync helper `for x in client.list_widgets_sync(req):` ts: `for await (const item of client.listWidgets())` + `.byPage()` helper.
Lina: telemetry: emit events for `pager_retry`, `resume_token_issued`, `token_version_mismatch`. helpful for production debugging.
ops-bot: CI: pager-unify branch tests passed (linux/py/ts) :white_check_mark:
Ivy: action items: Marcus draft Transport interface (unary, resume, stream) by Fri, Lina draft token v1 encoding + prefix by Thu, I'll write docs snippets and examples.
Marcus: will add error metadata shape including `retryable` and any `retry_after` seconds.
Lina: will draft the API metadata flag `stable_for_pagination` servers can set; SDKs warn when false and auto-dedupe enabled.
Ivy: great. keep surface tiny and consistent. we'll iterate on extras later. :thumbsup:
